mentions.name: Cloud cost management tool
mentions.description: This cloud cost management tool actively points out small, easy-to-miss cloud services that quietly charge month after month, whereas typical dashboards only show where the cloud bill goes.
mentions.problem: Existing dashboards show where the cloud bill goes but none actively flags small, easy-to-miss services that quietly charge monthly; each charge is tiny so nobody notices, but they add up over time.
mentions.source_excerpt: One example is cloud cost management. There are plenty of dashboards that show where your cloud bill goes, but I haven't found one that actively points out the small, easy-to-miss services that quietly charge you month after month. Each charge is tiny, so nobody notices, but over a long period they add up.
mentions.author: cloudcanalx
